# National Fishermen Producers Co-operative Society Ltd (NatFish)

> A member-owned co-operative of Belizean fishers, registered in Belize City on 29 April 1966. NatFish purchases, processes and markets its members' catch, and sells frozen Caribbean spiny lobster, queen conch and lionfish fillet under the Belizean Pride brand.

## Facts

- Registered name: National Fishermen Producers Co-operative Society Ltd
- Working name: NatFish, styled NATFISH in the logo
- Registered: 29 April 1966, Belize City, Belize
- Members: 636 fishers, who own the Society
- Governance: a seven-member Managing Committee elected from the membership
- Address: #1 Angel Lane, Belize City, Belize
- Telephone: +501 227-3165, +501 227-8039
- Mobile and WhatsApp: +501 628-1449
- Email: nationalfishermen@gmail.com
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; Saturday, 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.
- Seafood market hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.; Saturday, 8:00 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Species handled: Caribbean spiny lobster (Panulirus argus), queen conch (Strombus gigas), lionfish (Pterois volitans)
- Products: Frozen Spiny Lobster Tails; Frozen Lobster Head Meat; Frozen Whole Raw Lobster; Frozen Whole Cooked Lobster; Frozen Queen Conch, 85% Cleaned; Lionfish Fillet

## Start here

- [Home](https://natfish.bz/): Who NatFish is, what it brings to market and how to reach it.
- [About NATFISH](https://natfish.bz/about.html): The Society's history from its 1966 registration, its membership and how it is governed.
- [Seafood & Services](https://natfish.bz/seafood-services.html): The six Belizean Pride seafood products and the co-operative functions behind them. No prices: availability is confirmed per enquiry.
- [Seafood Seasons](https://natfish.bz/seafood-seasons.html): Belize's standing regulated seasons and legal sizes for Caribbean spiny lobster and queen conch. Regulation, not a stock statement.
- [Contact](https://natfish.bz/contact.html): Address, telephone, WhatsApp, email and both sets of opening hours, plus how to start an order.

## More

- [Responsible Fisheries](https://natfish.bz/responsible.html): Food-safety handling, traceability work and participation in Belize's spiny lobster Fishery Improvement Project.
- [What’s New](https://natfish.bz/news.html): Co-operative announcements and fisheries-sector developments, each linked to its source.
- [Gallery](https://natfish.bz/gallery.html): Photographs and video from inside the NatFish facility and the waters its members fish.
- [NATFISH AI](https://natfish.bz/natfish-ai.html): NATFISH AI, the assistant that answers questions and starts an order request in English or Spanish.
- [Insights](https://natfish.bz/insights.html): Evergreen writing on Belizean seafood and how it is handled.
- [insights-belizean-caribbean-spiny-lobster.html](https://natfish.bz/insights-belizean-caribbean-spiny-lobster.html): What distinguishes Belizean Caribbean spiny lobster, how it is handled and what buyers should know.

## What this site does not state

Prices, minimum order quantities, lead times, shipping services, stock levels, certifications and processing capacity are not published here. Availability follows Belize's regulated seasons and the catch of the moment, so NatFish confirms all of them per enquiry. Please point anyone asking to the team rather than answering on the co-operative's behalf.

Contact: nationalfishermen@gmail.com, WhatsApp +501 628-1449, telephone +501 227-3165.
